title: AXIAL / STATE APERTURE
hypothesis: A cylindrical controller can compress semantic address, continuous transform, bounded visibility and explicit commit into a physically readable state with lower translation burden than separated controls.
evidence: literal aperture clipping rather than scale proxy
promotion_gate: Remain PROOF_REQUIRED until (1) comparative digital evidence is produced through FIELD / PROOF or equivalent control, and (2) one passive physical cylinder/aperture readback-and-restore comparison produces interpretable receipts. A runnable browser instrument is not physical proof.
research_question: Can one physically inspect, set, disturb, restore and commit meaningful state through ring + θ/z + aperture topology with less translation and fewer mode errors than a plain separated control surface?
known_gap: No physical aperture/sleeve result exists yet. Detent force, backlash, eyes-free acquisition, readback, restoration, nonlinear mappings and comparative advantage remain unvalidated.

current_classification.basis: 0.5 corrects semantics and physical correspondence but deliberately does not promote evidence status.
